lockup.summary: Directors, officers and Pegasus cannot sell for 180 days after the prospectus date without the lead underwriter's consent. The company itself is locked up for 90 days.

what: It makes metal powders for 3D printing and large metal parts, mainly for defense, aerospace and medical uses, at a Tennessee plant.
proceeds: It plans to use up to about $10.0 million to buy equipment over the next 12 months. The rest is for general business needs such as working capital, running costs and research.
risks: The company has a history of losses, expects more losses, and will need to raise more money.
Its growth depends on being able to expand its metal powder and large-part production.
All its manufacturing is at one site, so a serious disruption there could hurt the whole business.
Unexpected costs or delays in bringing its powders and large parts to market could hurt its finances.
It may be unable to make powders that meet its customers' required specifications.
